result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I compiled `codeanalyzer`, which succeeded, but I didn't run any tests.

The change is one added condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`. A contributor matched by no team is added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true.

- **Blank dates:** `isActive()` already treats a blank latest-commit date as active, so those contributors stay in.
- **Configured teams:** their membership code is untouched, so they keep all members, active or not.
